title: [Betaflight] TASK_SERIAL maxExecutionTime/maxload permanently corrupted after USB VCP connect backpressure [low priority / established knowledge]
solutionSummary:
AI Generated issue-ticket

title: [ExpressLRS] Serial2: output all CRSF frames
solutionSummary:
If an output of a receiver is set to _Serial2 TX_  and the selected protocol is `CRSF` , the receiver outputs only RC-channel packages, no LINKSTAT or COMMAND.

So, the name CRSF here is wrong, because only a subset is outputted.

Please make it possible to use full-CRSF on _Serial2_ (together with _Serial2 RX_  for full-duplex).
